label: Management system standards
summary: Settles which ISO management system standard the organisation takes on and how it will be certified: the certificate type and body, the number of people in scope, the AI role for ISO/IEC 42001, and which risk, applicability and impact work already exists.

source.ref: Certification-body quote forms and service procedures: Stage 1, Stage 2, 3-year certificate, annual surveillance

fields.label: Certificate type
fields.note: A first certificate, a transfer from another body and a recertification follow different audit routes.

fields.label: Previous audit
fields.note: Whether the organisation has been audited against this standard before, by a certification body or internally.

fields.label: Audit report
fields.note: Optional: attach the latest audit report or certificate. It is kept in Evidence.

fields.label: People in scope
fields.note: People inside the scope, including contractors and freelancers (workers on site for ISO 45001). Certification bodies size the audit from this number.

fields.label: Certification body
fields.note: Whether a certification body has been chosen. It schedules the certification audits.

source.ref: Clauses 6.1.2 and 6.1.3 (risk criteria, risk treatment, Statement of Applicability); ISO 22301 BIA; ISO 42001 clause 6.1.4 impact assessment; ISO 45001 hazards and consultation

fields.label: AI role

source.ref: ISO/IEC 42001 clause 4.1 and ISO/IEC 22989 roles, as explained by certification and audit firms

fields.note: The organisation's role towards its AI systems decides which controls matter. One organisation can hold several roles.

fields.label: Risk method
fields.note: Whether a method for assessing risk already exists (hazards and OH&S risks for ISO 45001). Only its existence is asked; building it is the framework's work.

fields.label: Method document
fields.note: Optional: attach the risk assessment method as written. It is kept in Evidence.

fields.label: Existing SoA
fields.note: Whether a Statement of Applicability already exists. Only its existence is asked; the in-or-out decisions inside it are made in the framework's work.

fields.label: SoA document
fields.note: Optional: attach the current Statement of Applicability. It is kept in Evidence.

fields.label: Existing BIA
fields.note: Whether a business impact analysis already exists. Only its existence is asked; its content is the framework's work.

fields.label: BIA document
fields.note: Optional: attach the business impact analysis. It is kept in Evidence.

fields.label: Continuity plans
fields.note: Whether business continuity plans already exist. Only their existence is asked; writing and testing them is the framework's work.

fields.label: Plans document
fields.note: Optional: attach the continuity plans. It is kept in Evidence.

fields.label: Plans tested
fields.note: Whether the plans were ever exercised.

fields.label: AI use
fields.note: Where AI is used or planned; none ticked means it is not used yet. It tells which AI risks and controls matter.

fields.label: Impact assessments
fields.note: Whether AI system impact assessments already exist. Only their existence is asked.

fields.label: Assessment document
fields.note: Optional: attach an AI impact assessment. It is kept in Evidence.

fields.label: Work types
fields.note: The kinds of work in scope. They decide which hazards and legal requirements apply.

fields.label: Incident records
fields.note: Whether work-related incidents and injuries are already recorded.

gate.label: A transfer or recertification is not a new programme
gate.hint: A transfer or recertification means the system already exists. Change the starting point or the certificate type.
